output.summary: The decline is mostly not programming-driven. Single-ticket sales fell 45% at the Brightwater move versus a 9% peer median, and low-usage subscribers doubled in share. Exit and patron surveys name travel as the main reason (41% and 47%). Post-1945 concerts sell the same as others (1,034 vs 1,019 tickets). Core attenders renew at about 85%. Total decline (-29.9%) matches the peer median (-29%), though the timing differs from peers. Cathedral downtown concerts sold 1,520 tickets against 1,027 at Brightwater. Marketing impact is unmeasurable without attribution. Do not give non-renewal notice or cut repertoire. Present a segmented analysis to the board, use the cathedral dates, and pilot a shuttle.
